dimensions.assessment: Affects Medicare beneficiaries seeking mental health services and providers receiving Medicare reimbursement under the specified clauses.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XVIII of the Social Security Act to improve access to mental health services under the Medicare program.

dimensions.assessment: Adjusts Medicare reimbursement percentages for specific mental health items and services.
dimensions.evidence: by striking '75 percent of the amount determined for payment of a psychologist under clause (L)' and inserting '85 percent of the fee schedule amount provided under section 1848'

dimensions.assessment: Involves federal Medicare outlays due to increased percentage payments for specific services, though exact dollar figures are not stated.
Directly amends payment formulas within section 1833(a)(1) of the Social Security Act.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1833(a)(1) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395l(a)(1)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently to items and services furnished on or after January 1, 2027.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall apply to items and services furnished on or after January 1, 2027.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends Medicare payment rules to increase certain mental health service payments from 75 percent to 85 percent of the fee schedule amount.
